rows.quote: Data were collected from the FinnGen database (v11), which includes 297,867 controls and 43,132 patients of European descent.
rows.coder_note: 'FinnGen database (v11)' is version 11 modifying the dataset name, i.e. release 11 (rule A). The 297,867 controls and 43,132 patients are endpoint counts, not a release-defining N, and identify no other release (rule H).

rows.name_as_written: genome-wide Association Studies (GWAS) catalog of the European Institute for Bioinformatics (EBI)
rows.quote: The inflammatory factor dataset was obtained from the European Bioinformatics Institute genome-wide association study (EBI GWAS; https://ftp.ebi.ac/UK/pub/databases/gwas_summary_statistics/gwas) Catalog (accession numbers GCST90274758–GCST90274848) and the Department of Public Health and Primary Care (https://www.phpc.cam.ac.uk/ceu/proteins), with the former containing data on 1,400 metabolites.21
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the dataset by GWAS Catalog accessions GCST90274758–GCST90274848; no pQTL dictionary row lists these accessions, and the linked reference 21 is not a source of any pQTL row, so the dataset is named and absent from the dictionary (rules B, G).
